verdict.rationale: Rootly's schedule docs describe on-call schedules with rotations, layers, overrides, restrictions and previews that set who is on call at any time. Round-robin is documented as part of escalation policies. The pricing page adds holidays, PTO, shadowing and mobile shift swaps, so the core of the story is clearly covered in first-party material. Missing for 10: any explicit evidence of time-zone handling in schedules, round-robin documented within schedules rather than only escalation policies, and independent or hands-on corroboration of schedule building.
